ModMetaData.name: Creep Joiner: Time Traveler
ModMetaData.author: Steve
ModMetaData.description:
Adds a new creep-joiner form: a time traveler who is secretly a 20-30 year older copy of one of your current colonists. He shares scars and augmentations with his younger self, wears random high-tech gear, has a randomized name and stays for 30 days before he leaves the colony again. He is harmless - the player only recognizes who he once was through the shared scars and bionics.
Requires the Anomaly DLC for the creep-joiner system.
